component.name: imagen
component.summary: Capture the screen and annotate the result

description.p: imagen takes screenshots on Linux and lets you annotate them right away. It works on Wayland through the XDG desktop portal and on X11 directly.

ul.li: Capture the full desktop, a single monitor, a window or a region
Repeat the previous capture or reuse a fixed region
Annotate with arrows, lines, rectangles, ellipses, text and a freehand pen
Apply effects such as blur, pixelate, sharpen, invert or colour adjustments
Send the result to the clipboard, to a file, to a folder or to another program

description.p: First milestone: capture backends for Wayland and X11, global shortcuts, tray icon and a basic image editor.
